column1: Officer Moore looks at you in disgust. "Yeah, to a homicide dick like you, it's just one more dead body."
column2: 摩爾警官厭惡地看著你。「對你這種命案組混蛋來說，這只不過是另一具屍體。」

column1: I'm glad you came back anyway. Baby-sitting a corpse isn't my idea of a good time.
column2: 「不管怎樣，很高興你回來了。照顧屍體可不是我所謂的樂趣。」

column1: Yeah, even though you're working homicide, you're still human, Sonny.
column2: 「對，雖然你在命案組工作，你仍然是人，桑尼。」

column1: First, you apply the fingerprint powder.
column2: 首先，你撒上指紋粉。

column1: You brush the powder away, but the garbage can is "clean". There are no useful prints.
column2: 你刷去粉末，但垃圾桶是「乾淨的」。沒有可用的指紋。

column1: Where you're standing, there's nothing to fingerprint.
column2: 你站的位置沒有可採集指紋的東西。

column1: You photograph the crime scene from several different angles. Then you return the camera to the field kit.
column2: 你從幾個不同角度拍攝犯罪現場，然後把相機放回現場勘查箱。

column1: The man is dead. There can be no doubt.
column2: 男人死了。毫無疑問。

column1: You use the eye dropper to collect a sample of the coagulated blood and put it into the glass vial.
column2: 你用滴管採集凝固血液樣本，放入玻璃小瓶。

column1: You have already taken a cast of the footprint, and there's not enough casting plaster for another.
column2: 你已經為腳印翻模，沒有足夠的石膏再做一個。

column1: You remove the box of casting powder.
column2: 你取出翻模粉盒。

column1: You mix the powder to the proper consistency and pour it into the footprint depression.
column2: 你把粉末調成適當濃度，倒入腳印凹痕。

column1: After the liquid dries, you remove the impression of the footprint and add it to the list of evidence.
column2: 液體乾燥後，你取出腳印模型，加入證物清單。

column1: MERCY! Leave the poor guy where he is!
column2: 天啊！讓可憐的傢伙待在原地吧！

column1: You view the victim's body and see what appears to be a bullet hole in the head and superficial cuts and scratches on the throat.
column2: 你查看被害人屍體，看見頭部疑似彈孔，以及喉嚨上的表面割傷與抓痕。

column1: The hair and skin around the bullet hole have powder burns, indicating that the gun was very close to the victim's head.
column2: 彈孔周圍的頭髮和皮膚有火藥灼痕，表示槍口離被害人的頭非常近。

column1: The scratches on the victim's neck raise the possibility that the victim struggled with his killer.
column2: 被害人脖子上的抓痕顯示，他可能曾與殺手搏鬥。

column1: Looking at that yields no further clues.
column2: 查看那個沒有得到更多線索。

column1: Unlike its owner, the young man's watch is still ticking.
column2: 和主人不同，年輕人的手錶仍在滴答走動。

column1: It's not here.
column2: 它不在這裡。

column1: You need scuba equipment to go diving.
column2: 你需要水肺潛水裝備才能下水。

column1: YUK!
column2: 噁！

column1: Moving the garbage around, you find discarded clothing. Looking closer, you see what appears to be spots of blood on the clothes.
column2: 你翻動垃圾，找到丟棄的衣物。仔細一看，衣物上疑似有血跡。

column1: You move the garbage around, but all you see is more garbage.
column2: 你翻動垃圾，但只看到更多垃圾。

column1: Moving the garbage can wouldn't help you.!
column2: 移動垃圾桶也幫不上忙！
